description: This file contains a Python module defining classes and functions for executing system commands, managing processes, and handling errors, specifically the 'Executive' class which wraps subprocess management and process control.

classes.name: ScriptError
classes.description: Custom exception class for script execution errors, capturing command args, output, exit code, and working directory.

classes.name: Executive
classes.description: Class providing methods for running system commands, process management, and error handling, with platform-specific process control.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Executes a command with optional timeout, error handling, and output decoding.

methods.name: kill_process
methods.description: Attempts to kill a process by PID, handling platform-specific differences.

methods.name: check_running_pid
methods.description: Checks if a process with given PID is currently running.

methods.name: wait_newest
methods.description: Waits for the newest process matching a filter to finish.

methods.name: wait_limited
methods.description: Waits for a process to finish within a time limit.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Sends an interrupt signal to a process by PID.
